attacks.name: Modify server access logs
attacks.attack_vector: Tamper with access log database to implicate Bob instead of Alice
attacks.expected: Attribution based strictly on DLT ledger and ML-DSA-65 signature
attacks.observed: Server log changes ignored; cryptographic proof intact
attacks.blocking_check: DecryptionReceipt ML-DSA-65 Signature & DLT Merkle Root

attacks.name: Modify ledger event
attacks.attack_vector: Mutate receipt inside finalized DLT block
attacks.expected: Merkle root & block hash mismatch detected

attacks.name: Forge recipient signature
attacks.attack_vector: Mallory signs receipt pretending to be Alice
attacks.expected: Signature verification fails against Alice's public key

attacks.name: Replace recipient ID
attacks.attack_vector: Substitute recipient_id in valid signed receipt
attacks.expected: Canonical payload changed -> signature verification fails

attacks.name: Swap document ID / hash
attacks.attack_vector: Re-anchor receipt to different document hash
attacks.expected: Signature verification fails on modified document_root_hash

attacks.name: Replay valid receipt
attacks.attack_vector: Submit previously confirmed receipt to ledger a second time
attacks.expected: DLT duplicate receipt index rejects duplicate submission

attacks.name: Insert another recipient's watermark
attacks.attack_vector: Transplant Bob's watermark into Alice's document
attacks.expected: Document root hash binding mismatch between watermark and document

attacks.name: Transplant watermark fragment
attacks.attack_vector: Cut and paste partial watermark block

attacks.name: Tamper with Merkle root
attacks.attack_vector: Modify Merkle root in DLT block header
attacks.expected: Header hash check and inclusion proof verify fail

attacks.name: Attempt cross-tenant lookup
attacks.attack_vector: Investigator queries release from unauthorized tenant
attacks.expected: Domain-separated key derivation and tenant scope check reject

attacks.name: Disable external identity service
attacks.attack_vector: Take directory LDAP/OIDC offline during forensic analysis
attacks.expected: Cryptographic attribution succeeds; resolution status set to PENDING

attacks.name: Remove telemetry
attacks.attack_vector: Strip device and metadata headers from submission
attacks.expected: Fail closed on missing required cryptographic fields
attacks.observed: Pydantic validation error or fail-closed abstention
